integrity: The original general symmetric-inverse-semigroup conjugacy classification and the star element decomposition are credited; the new statement is the star-specific class/rank/size taxonomy and sharp stabilization. Direct finite enumeration is corroborative, not an infinite certificate. Independent audit is not performed.
limitations: Unweighted finite metric stars, \(m\ge2\); the one-leaf case has a separate formula. Natural inverse-semigroup conjugacy is not the unit-group conjugacy relation. No assertion about general trees, weighted stars or uniqueness in all historical literature.
title: Natural-conjugacy rank stabilization in finite star partial-isometry monoids
